title: Olaplex helps Henkel’s sales in Q3 as hair care acquisitions set to boost growth
summary: Henkel’s newly acquired hair care brands Olaplex and Not your Mother’s are expected to help deliver ‘above-average growth’ and €2bn of annual sales by 2030

extraction.key_fact: 헨켈이 새로 인수한 헤어케어 브랜드들이 성장을 이끌 것으로 기대된다.
